title: Krishan Gopal v. Dakhidanchal Vidut Vitaran Nigam Ltd.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Amreshwar Pratap Sahi, J.; Vivek Kumar Birla, J.
disposition: Writ disposed; licensee to decide the application under clause 6.5 within six weeks.
headnote: A consumer's writ seeking a direction to decide an application for meter installation and billing as per meter reading was disposed of by relegating the grievance to clause 6.5 of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005, with a direction to the licensee to decide the application within six weeks of a certified copy of the order being filed.
facts: Krishan Gopal petitioned the Allahabad High Court against Dakhidanchal Vidut Vitaran Nigam Ltd. and another. His only prayer was that the respondents be directed to decide his application regarding installation of a meter and raising of the bill as per the meter reading. Counsel for the petitioner and for the Power Corporation were heard. The Court did not go into the merits of that application.

holding_units.topic: meter installation and billing as per reading
holding_units.holding: A grievance seeking decision of an application for installation of a meter and for raising the bill as per the meter reading is redressable under clause 6.5 of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005; the licensee was directed to decide the application within six weeks of a certified copy of the order being filed, and the writ was disposed of without a merits determination.

not_decided.point: Whether a meter should be installed and the bill raised as per the meter reading
not_decided.note: Left to the licensee under clause 6.5.
